name: Scientific Energy, Inc.
summary: Scientific Energy, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, focuses on e-commerce platform business. It develops website that provides an e-commerce platform, where registered members could exchange goods and services. The company is involved in the provision of logistic services; group dining service platform for lunch and dinner group dining needs for corporate employees; and production and sale of graphite, and flash sales, and in-store services, as well as mobile platform of ordering and delivery services for restaurants and other merchants through Aomi App platform. Scientific Energy, Inc. was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Macau.
